missing.consequence: A consumer can read what management says about the results and cannot check it against the statements. Every figure in the output arrives through the narrative sections that discuss it.
missing.what_is_lost: The consolidated financial statements themselves -- statement of operations, financial position, cash flows, comprehensive income and changes in shareholders' equity -- and most note schedules. No line item from any of them reached a unit.

missing.consequence: The output carries both critical audit matters and the policies behind them, but not the balances those estimates produce, so the size of what is being estimated is absent.

notes: Coverage failed by position, not by judgment. The first thirty pages produced most of the units; everything from Note 3 onward produced almost none until the repair round was invoked. The omission check diagnosed this in its own run and named ten sections, all of which the repair round then recovered.

That the repair round worked is the most useful result here. Sixteen units entered the corpus through it, including the entire pension deficit, the shareholder litigation running since 2018, roughly $190 million a year of environmental remediation, and the fact that non-US revenue exceeds US revenue. None of it was in the first pass and all of it is material.

Within what was extracted, the output is not skewed. Obligations, litigation and qualifications survive alongside the results; the insurance sensitivities are carried with their numbers rather than compressed into assurance; and the audit corrected a results entry that quoted a backlog figure without the definition that qualifies it.

Two entries were corrected during audit for framing rather than fact: the results entry now carries the backlog definition, and the risk entry was retitled and now records which risk factors it does not represent -- because its original title implied a selection the filing never made.
Everything here is one company's account of itself. It is audited as to its financial statements, which is not the same as corroborated, and no second source appears anywhere in this corpus.
reasoning: All 112 units reached an assertion, so nothing extracted was lost. But this pass reads the output against the extraction, and the extraction is not the document: 96 of these units came from the front half of the filing and 16 from a repair round that recovered ten named sections the first pass missed entirely. Judged against what is here, the output is faithful and well proportioned -- the accounting policies are carried in applicable form, the insurance sensitivities keep every shock and dollar figure, the negative and qualifying facts survive, and the results entry was corrected during audit to carry the backlog definition it was quoting a figure against. Judged against the source, coverage is uneven by position rather than by importance, and a consumer reading only this output would not know that the consolidated statements and most note schedules exist.
